synced.text: Songs Title：the dividing line
Strangelove 奇异之爱
Dance the dividing line 在分界线上起舞
We shall burn the earth 我们将焚尽大地
We shall burn our lives 我们将燃尽生命
For the tallest tree shall battle most 最高的树必将经历最猛烈的战斗
The wind it leaves the week behind 狂风将弱者尽数抛却
The storm that you＇ve denied me 你拒绝承认的风暴
Shall force your world to fall 终将摧毁你的世界
Your castles made to tremble 你摇摇欲坠的城堡
With foundations based upon a lie 根基创建在谎言之上
The storm that you＇ve denied me 你拒绝承认的风暴
Sweep the undivided truth 席卷着不容分割的真相
His mind shall not of thoughts be tempted 他的意志不受蛊惑
Nor words can heal his bleeding scars 言语难愈他流血的伤痕
We must burn our minds 我们必须焚尽思想
Colours collide with the world of his beliefs 色彩与他信仰的世界激烈碰撞
Bring back the storm of distant years 唤回遥远岁月的风暴
Tumbling  trembling as there is no waking up 翻滚战栗 永无苏醒之日
There is no dividing line as logic now fails 逻辑崩塌 再无界限可言
Stream upwards  rage against them all 逆流而上 向万物咆哮
Speak of words hidden in your song 诉说深藏歌中的密语
Mere mortals strive for length in numbers 凡夫俗子追逐虚妄永恒
There is no dividing line 世间本无分界
As the writer defies the empty page 如作家对抗空白篇章
The empty mind its feed shall seek 空虚的心灵寻求滋养
Pass on to the frail and mindless 传递给脆弱与无知者
Now what sanity discards 如今理智所抛弃的
The storm shall sweep the weak of heart 风暴将席卷怯懦之心
And tear your castles down 并摧毁你的城堡
Crush the very foundations 粉碎你所信仰的根基
On which your faith is based 你信念所依存的支柱
Torn across the dividing line 跨越那道分界线
